svg.title: Final app usability verification
svg.desc: A separate disposable profile then loaded HTTPS example.com with HTTP 200, read its snapshot and rendered a screenshot; completed a localhost form through trusted native fill/click; loaded the inspector at 1280×900 and 390×844 with no page overflow or UI errors; rejected unauthenticated inspector state with 403; kept preview off by default; captured a frame only on request; displayed the native Accounts window; and kept the daemon usable after that window closed. Native, desktop/mobile inspector and public-page images were visually inspected. All owned profile files and daemons were removed.
